name: Water Wave Double-Slit
description: Classic Young double-slit experiment with water waves. A single oscillator generates circular ripples; a barrier with two slits creates two coherent sources. Observe the characteristic interference pattern of alternating bright and dark radial bands.

successCriteria.description: Observe alternating bright and dark bands radiating from the slits
Change slit separation and observe how fringe spacing changes

hints.message: The two slits act as independent wave sources. Where crests overlap = bright band; crest + trough = dark band.
Drag Frequency to change wavelength; Slit Size/Separation to change the interference geometry.

inquiryTask.question: 改变缝间距和波长，观察双缝干涉条纹的疏密变化，条纹间距与什么有关？

steps.instruction: 保持频率 0.4，把缝间距调到 12（最小），观察条纹并点击「记录本次实验」。
把缝间距调到 36（最大），再次观察并记录。
steps.hint: 缝间距越大，条纹越密还是越疏？

steps.instruction: 再试试改变频率，归纳条纹间距的影响因素。

inquiryTask.referenceConclusion: 缝间距 d 越大，条纹越密；波长 λ 越大（频率越低），条纹越疏。公式：d·sinθ = n·λ，条纹间距与缝间距成反比、与波长成正比。
